summary: Use runtime fallback when await may encounter an arbitrary thenable with dynamic JavaScript property semantics.

requirements.operand: not proven primitive, intrinsic Promise, or non-thenable

target.notes: Runtime must perform PromiseResolve-style dynamic then lookup, getter execution, callability checks, and one-shot resolution.

semantics.then_call: callable then is invoked with the thenable as this

caveats: Static Task conversion cannot reproduce arbitrary getters, Proxy traps, or monkey-patched then properties.
